children: Thailand's retail sector is showing strengthening signs of demand recovery, CGS International's Chaiyatorn Sricharoen says in a research report. Improving sales in Dohome's back-office channel, which primarily sells building materials, in July-August has boosted the brokerage's confidence that Thailand's construction pipeline is translating into demand. Based on recent sales momentum, this channel is likely to have maintained a high-single-digit percentage same-store-sales growth in September, even as the favorable comparison from last year's steel shortage ended. This suggests underlying demand is improving, the analyst says. The brokerage recommends positioning for a modest upturn in Thailand's retail sector, and upgrades the sector to overweight from neutral. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
